description: Representative LaMont will be meeting community members at the annual Harvest Dinner in Elmore on Saturday, Oct. 5 beginning at 5 p.m. The menu includes ham, baked potato, squash, peas, beets, bread, salad, dessert, coffee, tea, milk and cider. title: Elmore Fire Department Harvest Dinner — Saudia LaMont for Vermont
